Amouage’s Overture 41 Extrait de Parfum presents a concentrated amber and woody composition. Saffron and Calvados enrich the opening with warm spice and vibrant depth. Rose and sandalwood develop over amber and patchouli, giving you a rich scent with a deep, lasting presence.

• 100ml

• Extrait de Parfum

• 41% fragrance concentration

Key Notes: 

• Top Notes: Frankincense, Saffron, Calvados, Cinnamon

• Heart Notes: Benzoin, Rose Centifolia, Geranium, Sandalwood Drèches

• Base Notes: Vanilla, Labdanum, Patchouli, Leather
